subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the keyframe of [Shot 1]: close on the girl in the daytime, lit from below by a laptop screen, a pleased, surprised little smile.

summary: [keyframe completion] Watching her first clip, the girl breaks into a pleased smile.

retention_analysis: <Picture 1> ([Shot 1] keyframe): partially_preserved - the framing, the set, the light, the line and the colours hold through the whole shot, and the girl's face, hair and clothing; its pose is the moment the motion passes through, as the description writes it.

detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] The shot's keyframe corresponds to <Picture 1>, whose framing, set and light hold from the first frame to the last. Soft, cool daylight; the rainy window glows at the left, a fold of pale violet curtain behind her. Close on the girl, a cool white glow rising onto her face from the screen just below the frame. Her eyebrows lift in surprise and her eyes widen a little, then the corners of her mouth curl up and the smile spreads over her whole face, her cheeks turning pink, her shoulders giving one small happy bounce. The girl (S1), an early-teens girl with a bright, light, crisp voice, says it with a small happy bounce, surprised it came out better than she expected, <d>[English] Oh! Not bad!</d> Her lips close and the speaking motion stops, and she keeps smiling down at the screen. The camera holds a static shot. Through every frame the picture keeps the look of <Picture 1>: the same bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, the same bright flat cel colours with one simple step of soft shading, the same palette and light, drawn as hand-animated 2D anime with crisp, steady line work. The girl keeps her look exactly as in <Picture 1> in every frame: a wavy black bob with violet-dyed tips underneath and one small curl sticking up on top, a white headband printed with violet stars tied in a big bow on top of her head, a black choker, an oversized white hoodie with a violet konte logo on the chest and a thin violet shoulder-bag strap across it, her face, big dark eyes and hair shape unchanged.

overall_soundscape: Soft steady rain patters on the window glass, with a faint, quiet bedroom room tone underneath. The faint sound of rain playing from the laptop's small speaker.
